newsitem.title: ITALY: IFI 1996 cons profit 447 billion lire.
newsitem.headline: IFI 1996 cons profit 447 billion lire.

text.p: The Agnelli family holding company IFI on Wednesday said that its 1996 consolidated attributable net profit rose to 447 billion lire from 411 billion in 1995.
The group said in a statement that it was raising its 1996 dividends on its ordinary and privilege shares each by 40 lire a share to 440 lire and 490 lire a share respectively.
At the parent company level, IFI's 1996 net profits rose 57 percent to 82 billion lire from 52 billion lire in 1995.

IFI is largely owned by the Agnelli family and in turn IFI has a controlling stake in industrial holding company IFIL. IFI and IFIL together have a stake of 32.2 percent in Italian industrial giant Fiat.
At the group consolidated level, IFI's net financial position stayed positive at 36 billion lire, the statement added.
